10          Plaintiffs filed a motion to seal certain exhibits in support of its statement regarding 
11 ||  missing discovery (at ECF No. 83). ECF No. 84. They also filed a motion to seal certain exhibits 
12 || to the October 2025 joint status report (at ECF No. 86). ECF No. 87. The sealed documents are 
13 || currently at ECF Nos. 85 and 88. Plaintiffs rely on the protective order entered into by the parties 
14 ||  as the rationale for sealing/redacting documents in both motions. Stipulated protective orders 
15 ||  alone do not justify sealing court records. Kamakana vy. City & Cnty. of Honolulu, 447 F.3d 1172, 
16 |}  1183 (9th Cir. 2006). 
17          Rather than respond to these motions, Defendants filed their own motions to seal the same 
18 || documents identified in Plaintiffs’ motions. ECF Nos. 90 and 95. 
19          IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED that Plaintiffs’ motions to seal (ECF Nos. 84 and 87) 
20 || are DENIED without prejudice. It appears it is Defendants who wish to maintain the documents 
21 ||  in question under seal given the motions they filed at ECF Nos. 90 and 95. Thus, this Court will 
22 ||  resolve those motions in due course. However, the Clerk’s Office is directed to maintain ECF 
23 || Nos. 85 and 88 under seal until further orders from the Court. 
24 
25          DATED: December 4, 2025
